mapper.insert: INSERT INTO team (team_name, captain, description) VALUES (#{teamName}, #{captain}, #{description})
mapper.select: SELECT id, team_name, captain, description, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player WHERE team_id = team.id) AS member_count, create_time, update_time FROM team WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT id, team_name, captain, description, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player WHERE team_id = team.id) AS member_count, create_time, update_time FROM team
AND team_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.teamName}, '%')
AND captain LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.captain}, '%')
ORDER BY update_time DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, team_name, captain, description, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM player WHERE team_id = team.id) AS member_count, create_time, update_time FROM team
AND ( team_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR captain LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY update_time DESC, id DESC
